final.uncertainty_method: Percentile paired cluster bootstrap; resample 87 authored semantic groups with replacement, retain all their case variants; same resample for all releases. These nonrandom synthetic groups are not a representative customer sample, so intervals describe this audit's group sensitivity rather than production generalization.

v4_routing_metrics.exclusions: No-message access/input tests and explicitly stubbed routing adapter cases. Separate from grouped Bitext source holdout.
v4_routing_metrics.score_semantics: Scope-rule decisions are deterministic scope denials, not model probabilities. Probability calibration must exclude those decisions.

final.interpretation: V4 improves paired workflow coverage but accepts 4 wrong routes/104 and 1 unsupported case/40. 27 rule denials are not model probabilities; 6 human requests were over-denied into unsupported scope. Every cancellation still needs an authorized exact-proposal approval. No model tuning followed this audit.

resources.scope: One fresh Python process per model, same80 historical diagnostic messages. Cold model load/first query after library imports; warm per-message latency. Peak process RSS includes interpreter/libraries. Single local CPU run, no cloud cost/throughput inference.

retrieval.labeling: Synthetic policies/queries and relevance labels authored by coding agent. No independent human adjudication.
retrieval.lexical_semantics: Legacy all uses AND plainto_tsquery and retains zero-score ranks. New any uses parameterized OR websearch terms and excludes zero-score lexical entries from ranking/fusion. No main pipeline configuration is changed.
retrieval.latency_scope: Warm retrieval with a new scoped runtime-role transaction per query; local CPU/PostgreSQL. Excludes fixture seed, routing, generation and provider calls.
retrieval.limitations: 32 agent-authored synthetic queries,16 per split; no independent human relevance adjudication or representative traffic sample. Ranking comparison does not establish answer factuality or retrieval abstention on unknown topics. Main demo still retains its previous corpus/retrieval release.
